entities.name: Archaic Peoples and Early Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The earliest inhabitants of Trinidad, arriving from the South American mainland (Trinidad lies only 11 km off Venezuela), were Archaic Age hunter-gatherers. Archaeological sites at Banwari Trace (c. 5000 BCE) contain some of the oldest human remains in the Caribbean.
